title: Help Center

purpose.en: Read what every screen and report is for, how to use it step by step, and what each field means. Open it when you are not sure how a screen works.
purpose.id: Membaca kegunaan tiap layar dan laporan, cara pakainya langkah demi langkah, dan arti tiap isian. Buka saat Anda ragu cara kerja sebuah layar.

keywords: help, help center, bantuan, pusat bantuan, panduan, cara pakai, petunjuk, manual, arti isian, penjelasan

steps.en: Type the screen name, or what you want to do, in the search box.
steps.id: Ketik nama layar, atau apa yang ingin Anda kerjakan, di kotak cari.

steps.en: Use the filter row to show only General guide, Input screen or Report.
steps.id: Pakai baris filter untuk menampilkan hanya General guide, Input screen, atau Report.

steps.en: Open the row to read the steps of how to use the screen, followed by the explanation of every field.
steps.id: Buka barisnya untuk membaca langkah cara pakai layar itu, lalu penjelasan tiap isian.

steps.en: Group by Module to see all help of one module together.
steps.id: Kelompokkan per Module untuk melihat semua bantuan satu modul sekaligus.

fields.label: Screen
fields.en: Name of the screen, report or general guide, as written in the menu.
fields.id: Nama layar, laporan, atau panduan umum, seperti tertulis di menu.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: General guide = applies to every screen; Input screen = data is entered there; Report = read only.
fields.id: General guide = berlaku untuk semua layar; Input screen = tempat mengisi data; Report = hanya dibaca.

fields.label: Module
fields.en: Module that owns the screen. Use it as a filter or as the group.
fields.id: Modul pemilik layar. Bisa dipakai sebagai filter atau grup.

fields.label: What it is for
fields.en: One or two sentences on what the screen is used for and when to open it.
fields.id: Satu atau dua kalimat tentang kegunaan layar dan kapan membukanya.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.en: Search words of the topic. Hidden by default; switch it on with the Columns button.
fields.id: Kata cari topik. Tersembunyi; nyalakan lewat tombol Columns.

title: Help Topics

purpose.en: Maintain the list of help topics: one row per screen, report or general guide, with what it is for and its search words. The Help Center and the AI assistant read it.
purpose.id: Merawat daftar topik bantuan: satu baris per layar, laporan, atau panduan umum, berisi kegunaan dan kata carinya. Dibaca Help Center dan asisten AI.

keywords: help topics, topik bantuan, isi help, tambah bantuan, edit bantuan, kata cari, keywords, setup help

steps.en: Find the topic with the search box, or click Row to add a new one.
steps.id: Cari topiknya lewat kotak cari, atau klik Row untuk menambah yang baru.

steps.en: Click a cell and type. Fill Key, Type, Title and Purpose (English); add the Indonesian text in the column next to it.
steps.id: Klik sel lalu ketik. Isi Key, Type, Title, dan Purpose (English); teks Indonesianya di kolom sebelahnya.

steps.en: Click Save. All changed rows are saved together; a row with a mistake is marked and nothing is saved until it is fixed.
steps.id: Klik Save. Semua baris yang berubah disimpan bersama; baris yang salah ditandai dan tidak ada yang tersimpan sampai diperbaiki.

steps.en: Open Help Lines to write the steps and the field explanations of the topic.
steps.id: Buka Help Lines untuk menulis langkah dan penjelasan isian topik itu.

steps.en: To retire a topic, clear its Active check and Save. It disappears from the Help Center.
steps.id: Untuk menghentikan sebuah topik, hapus centang Active lalu Save. Topik hilang dari Help Center.

fields.label: Key
fields.en: Address of the screen as in Menu Setup, without v2: (for example customer-order); guide-... for a general guide. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Cannot be changed after Save.
fields.id: Alamat layar seperti di Menu Setup, tanpa v2: (mis. customer-order); guide-... untuk panduan umum. Huruf kecil, angka, dan tanda hubung. Tidak bisa diubah setelah Save.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Input screen, Report, or General guide.
fields.id: Input screen, Report, atau General guide.

fields.label: Module
fields.en: Module that owns the screen, picked from the module list.
fields.id: Modul pemilik layar, dipilih dari daftar modul.

fields.label: Title
fields.en: Screen name in English, as written in the menu. At most 150 characters.
fields.id: Nama layar dalam English, seperti di menu. Paling panjang 150 karakter.

fields.label: Purpose (English)
fields.en: What the screen is for and when to open it, in English. At most 255 characters.
fields.id: Untuk apa layar itu dan kapan dibuka, dalam English. Paling panjang 255 karakter.

fields.label: Indonesian
fields.en: The same purpose in Indonesian. Empty = shown in English.
fields.id: Kegunaan yang sama dalam bahasa Indonesia. Kosong = tampil English.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.en: Words people type when they look for this screen, English and Indonesian, separated by commas.
fields.id: Kata yang diketik orang saat mencari layar ini, English dan Indonesia, dipisah koma.

fields.label: Order
fields.en: Number that sets the position of the topic inside its module; smaller comes first.
fields.id: Angka urutan topik di dalam modulnya; yang kecil lebih dulu.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Checked = shown in the Help Center and used by the assistant.
fields.id: Dicentang = tampil di Help Center dan dipakai asisten.

title: Help Lines

purpose.en: Maintain the content of each help topic in short texts: the steps of how to use the screen and the explanation of every field or report column.
purpose.id: Merawat isi tiap topik bantuan dalam teks pendek: langkah cara pakai layar dan penjelasan tiap isian atau kolom laporan.

keywords: help lines, isi bantuan, langkah cara pakai, penjelasan isian, penjelasan kolom, edit help, terjemahan help

steps.en: Type the topic name in the search box to see only its lines.
steps.id: Ketik nama topik di kotak cari untuk melihat barisnya saja.

steps.en: Click Row to add a line, pick the Topic and the Kind.
steps.id: Klik Row untuk menambah baris, pilih Topic dan Kind.

steps.en: For a field explanation, type the Field label exactly as written on the screen.
steps.id: Untuk penjelasan isian, ketik label Field persis seperti di layar.

steps.en: Write the text in English and its Indonesian version in the next column. One action or one fact per line.
steps.id: Tulis teksnya dalam English dan versi Indonesianya di kolom sebelahnya. Satu tindakan atau satu fakta per baris.

steps.en: Set Order to place the line inside the topic, then click Save.
steps.id: Isi Order untuk menempatkan baris di dalam topik, lalu klik Save.

fields.label: Topic
fields.en: The help topic this line belongs to, picked from Help Topics.
fields.id: Topik bantuan pemilik baris ini, dipilih dari Help Topics.

fields.label: Kind
fields.en: How to use (step) = one step, shown in order; Field explanation = what one field or column means.
fields.id: How to use (step) = satu langkah, tampil berurutan; Field explanation = arti satu isian atau kolom.

fields.label: Field
fields.en: Label of the field or column exactly as on the screen. Required for a field explanation, empty for a step.
fields.id: Label isian atau kolom persis seperti di layar. Wajib untuk penjelasan isian, kosong untuk langkah.

fields.label: Text (English)
fields.en: The step or explanation in English, at most 255 characters.
fields.id: Langkah atau penjelasan dalam English, paling panjang 255 karakter.

fields.label: Indonesian
fields.en: The same text in Indonesian. Empty = shown in English.
fields.id: Teks yang sama dalam bahasa Indonesia. Kosong = tampil English.

fields.label: Order
fields.en: Sequence of the line inside its topic; smaller comes first.
fields.id: Urutan baris di dalam topiknya; yang kecil lebih dulu.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Checked = shown in the Help Center and used by the assistant.
fields.id: Dicentang = tampil di Help Center dan dipakai asisten.

title: Assistant Questions

purpose.en: Maintain the number questions the AI assistant knows: the words that trigger each question and who may ask it. The number itself is calculated by the program.
purpose.id: Merawat pertanyaan angka yang dikenal asisten AI: kata pemicu tiap pertanyaan dan siapa yang boleh bertanya. Angkanya sendiri dihitung program.

keywords: assistant questions, pertanyaan asisten, asisten ai, frasa pemicu, kata pemicu, level pertanyaan, katalog angka, metric

steps.en: Find the question by its title or key.
steps.id: Cari pertanyaannya lewat judul atau key.

steps.en: Click the Trigger phrases cell and add the words people really type, in any language, separated by commas.
steps.id: Klik sel Trigger phrases lalu tambahkan kata yang benar-benar diketik orang, bahasa apa pun, dipisah koma.

steps.en: Set Module and Minimum level to decide who gets the answer; everyone else is told it is not available for their account.
steps.id: Atur Module dan Minimum level untuk menentukan siapa yang mendapat jawabannya; yang lain diberi tahu bahwa itu tidak tersedia untuk akunnya.

steps.en: Click Save. The change applies to the next question asked.
steps.id: Klik Save. Perubahan berlaku pada pertanyaan berikutnya.

steps.en: To stop a question, clear its Active check and Save.
steps.id: Untuk menghentikan sebuah pertanyaan, hapus centang Active lalu Save.

fields.label: Key
fields.en: Key of the program class that calculates the number. Set by the developer; it cannot be changed, and a row without a class cannot be saved.
fields.id: Key kelas program yang menghitung angkanya. Diisi developer; tidak bisa diubah, dan baris tanpa kelas tidak bisa disimpan.

fields.label: Title
fields.en: Name of the question in English; shown as an example question in the assistant.
fields.id: Nama pertanyaan dalam English; tampil sebagai contoh pertanyaan di asisten.

fields.label: Trigger phrases
fields.en: Phrases that select this question, any language, separated by commas. A phrase matches when all its words are in the question.
fields.id: Frasa yang memilih pertanyaan ini, bahasa apa pun, dipisah koma. Frasa cocok bila semua katanya ada di pertanyaan.

fields.label: Module
fields.en: Module the asker must be allowed to open under user security. Users who may open Management Reports may ask every module. Empty = everyone.
fields.id: Modul yang harus boleh dibuka si penanya menurut user security. User yang boleh membuka Laporan Manajemen boleh bertanya semua modul. Kosong = semua orang.

fields.label: Minimum level
fields.en: Lowest security level (group management level) that gets the answer, on top of the module right. 0 = the module right is enough.
fields.id: Level security terendah (level manajemen grup) yang mendapat jawaban, di atas hak modul. 0 = hak modul sudah cukup.

fields.label: Order
fields.en: Position of the question in the list and among the example questions.
fields.id: Urutan pertanyaan di daftar dan di antara contoh pertanyaan.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Checked = the assistant answers this question.
fields.id: Dicentang = asisten menjawab pertanyaan ini.

title: Assistant Log

purpose.en: Lists every question asked to the AI assistant and the kind of answer it gave. Open it to find questions that were not answered or got a thumbs down, then add Help or trigger phrases.
purpose.id: Daftar semua pertanyaan ke asisten AI dan jenis jawabannya. Buka untuk menemukan pertanyaan yang tidak terjawab atau dijempol turun, lalu tambahkan Help atau frasa pemicu.

keywords: assistant log, log asisten, pertanyaan tidak terjawab, riwayat asisten, jempol turun, feedback asisten, pertanyaan user

steps.en: Click Not answered or Thumbs down in the filter row.
steps.id: Klik Not answered atau Thumbs down di baris filter.

steps.en: Read the Question column to see what people asked in their own words.
steps.id: Baca kolom Question untuk melihat apa yang ditanyakan orang dengan kata-katanya sendiri.

steps.en: Add the missing answer: a help text in Help Lines, a keyword in Help Topics, or a trigger phrase in Assistant Questions.
steps.id: Tambahkan jawaban yang kurang: teks bantuan di Help Lines, kata cari di Help Topics, atau frasa pemicu di Assistant Questions.

steps.en: Group by Asked by or Answer kind to see who uses the assistant and for what.
steps.id: Kelompokkan per Asked by atau Answer kind untuk melihat siapa yang memakai asisten dan untuk apa.

fields.label: Asked at
fields.en: Date and time of the question.
fields.id: Tanggal dan jam pertanyaan.

fields.label: Asked by
fields.en: Name of the user who asked.
fields.id: Nama user yang bertanya.

fields.label: Level
fields.en: Security level of the user when asking. It decides how long the row is kept: 30, 14 or 7 days.
fields.id: Level security user saat bertanya. Menentukan lama baris disimpan: 30, 14, atau 7 hari.

fields.label: Question
fields.en: The question as typed.
fields.id: Pertanyaan seperti yang diketik.

fields.label: Answer kind
fields.en: Screen = a screen was found; Help = quoted from the Help; Number = calculated number; Denied = outside the rights of the user; Not answered = no answer found.
fields.id: Screen = layar ditemukan; Help = dikutip dari Help; Number = angka hasil hitung; Denied = di luar hak user; Not answered = tidak ada jawaban.

fields.label: Source
fields.en: Key of the number question, help topic or screen the answer came from.
fields.id: Key pertanyaan angka, topik bantuan, atau layar asal jawaban.

fields.label: Feedback
fields.en: Thumbs up or Thumbs down given by the asker; empty when not rated.
fields.id: Thumbs up atau Thumbs down dari penanya; kosong bila tidak dinilai.

fields.label: Answer
fields.en: Short form of the answer shown. Hidden by default; switch it on with the Columns button.
fields.id: Bentuk singkat jawaban yang ditampilkan. Tersembunyi; nyalakan lewat tombol Columns.

fields.label: Local model
fields.en: Yes when the local language model was asked for this answer. Hidden by default.
fields.id: Yes bila model bahasa lokal ikut ditanya untuk jawaban ini. Tersembunyi.

fields.label: Duration (ms)
fields.en: Time the assistant needed to answer, in milliseconds. Hidden by default.
fields.id: Waktu yang dibutuhkan asisten untuk menjawab, dalam milidetik. Tersembunyi.

title: AI Assistant

purpose.en: Explains the AI assistant: a private chat that finds screens, explains how to use them from the Help, and answers numbers you are allowed to see. It works without internet.
purpose.id: Menjelaskan asisten AI: chat pribadi yang mencarikan layar, menjelaskan cara pakainya dari Help, dan menjawab angka yang boleh Anda lihat. Bekerja tanpa internet.

keywords: asisten ai, assistant, ai, tanya asisten, chat asisten, cari layar, tanya angka, bantuan otomatis

steps.en: Open the account menu and click Asisten AI. A drawer opens on the right with your own conversation.
steps.id: Buka menu akun lalu klik Asisten AI. Drawer terbuka di kanan berisi percakapan Anda sendiri.

steps.en: Type a question in plain words, or click one of the example questions.
steps.id: Ketik pertanyaan dengan bahasa biasa, atau klik salah satu contoh pertanyaan.

steps.en: To find a screen, type its name or what it is for; click the Open button in the answer to open it as a tab.
steps.id: Untuk mencari layar, ketik namanya atau kegunaannya; klik tombol Open di jawaban untuk membukanya sebagai tab.

steps.en: To learn a screen, start with how or cara; the assistant shows the steps from the Help.
steps.id: Untuk belajar sebuah layar, awali dengan cara atau how; asisten menampilkan langkah dari Help.

steps.en: To ask a number, type it as you would say it, for example sales today or deadstock value.
steps.id: Untuk bertanya angka, ketik seperti Anda mengucapkannya, misalnya sales hari ini atau nilai deadstock.

steps.en: Rate the answer with thumbs up or thumbs down; a bad or missing answer is recorded for the support team.
steps.id: Nilai jawabannya dengan jempol naik atau turun; jawaban yang buruk atau kosong dicatat untuk tim support.

fields.label: Asisten AI
fields.en: Account menu item that opens the assistant drawer.
fields.id: Item menu akun yang membuka drawer asisten.

fields.label: Open
fields.en: Button in an answer; opens the named screen or report as a work tab and closes the drawer.
fields.id: Tombol di jawaban; membuka layar atau laporan itu sebagai tab kerja dan menutup drawer.

fields.label: How to use
fields.en: Button in an answer; shows the how-to steps of that screen.
fields.id: Tombol di jawaban; menampilkan langkah cara pakai layar itu.

fields.label: Not available for your account
fields.en: Shown when a number is outside your user security rights. Numbers follow the module rights and security level of your account.
fields.id: Tampil bila sebuah angka di luar hak user security Anda. Angka mengikuti hak modul dan level security akun Anda.

fields.label: Send as Support Ticket
fields.en: Shown when the assistant has no answer; opens the Support Ticket page so you can send the question to the support team.
fields.id: Tampil bila asisten tidak punya jawaban; membuka halaman Tiket Bantuan supaya pertanyaan bisa dikirim ke tim support.
